name: Full name of the patient
exacerbating_factors: Exacerbating factors of the patient's illness
relieving_factors: Relieving factors of the patient's illness
associated_symptoms: Associated symptoms of the patient's illness
number_of_episodes: Number of episodes per day of the patient's complaint
severity: Severity of the patient's illness on a scale of 1-10
previous_admission: Previous admission to hospital and the reason for admission
previous_diagnosis: Previous diagnosis of diagnosis, asthma, sickle cell, hypertension or any other relevant disease based on patient's presenting complaint.
previous_surgery: Previous surgery and the reason for surgery
current_medication: Current medications, including dosage and frequency if it is a prescription drug
allergies: Allergies to medications, food, or other environmental factors, specifying the type of reaction and severity if applicable
herbal_drug_use: Use of herbal drugs, including form, dosage, route and frequency if applicable
family_medical_history: Family history of diabetes, asthma, sickle cell, hypertension, cancer or any other relevant diseases based on patient's presenting complaint.
smoking: Whether the patient smokes or not and if yes, how many sticks per day
alcohol: Whether the patient drinks alcohol or not and if yes, the quantity and frequency
recreational_drug_use: Whether the patient uses recreational drugs or not and if yes, the quantity and frequency. (Give examples of recreational drugs based on patient's condition)
diet: Patient's diet and eating habit (Give examples of foods that could contribute to patient's condition)
psychosocial_history: Emotional well-being and mental health. How the patient is feeling about his or her illness
additional_info: Any additional information that the patient may want to share.
